stories.title: "Nous nous devons plus que jamais de mener la bataille sociale" : en meeting à Hénin-Beaumont, Marine Le Pen tente de retrouver les accents de sa campagne présidentielle de 2022

en.title: "We must now more than ever wage the social battle": At a rally in Hénin-Beaumont, Marine Le Pen attempts to recapture the tone of her 2022 presidential campaign
en.summary: Marine Le Pen held her political comeback rally Sunday in her stronghold in Pas-de-Calais, focusing on housing issues and purchasing power.

stories.title: Coupe du monde féminine de basket : surclassées par les Américaines en finale, les Françaises repartent en argent

en.title: Women's Basketball World Cup: French team wins silver after losing to Americans in final
en.summary: France's women's basketball team lost to the United States 79-97 in Sunday's World Cup final in Berlin. Despite the defeat, France secured its first-ever world silver medal in the sport.

stories.title: Suspense maximal pour les législatives en Suède : la coalition de gauche en tête d'un cheveu, alors que le dépouillement n'est pas terminé

en.title: Maximum suspense for Swedish legislative elections: left-wing coalition ahead by a hair, as counting is not finished
en.summary: Swedish legislative elections show the left-wing coalition narrowly leading over the right-wing and far-right alliance in early results, with far-right support declining according to exit polls.

stories.title: Législatives en Suède : la gauche au coude à coude avec l’extrême droite en recul

en.title: Swedish legislative elections: left neck-and-neck with far-right in decline
en.summary: Left-wing parties and the right-extreme right alliance are nearly tied in Swedish elections, with the far-right performing worse than expected after holding power since 2022.

stories.title: Mondial de basket : les Bleues s'inclinent en finale face aux invincibles Américaines

en.title: Basketball World Cup: French women lose in final against unbeatable Americans
en.summary: France's women's basketball team lost the World Cup final to the United States 79-97 in Berlin, with the Americans remaining undefeated in major competitions for 20 years.

stories.title: Coupe du monde du basket : malgré un départ canon, les Bleues calent face aux reines américaines

en.title: Basketball World Cup: despite a strong start, French women falter against American queens
en.summary: France's basketball team led at halftime but ultimately fell to Team USA in the World Cup final, securing the silver medal.

stories.title: Pas de premier titre mondial pour l’équipe de France, battue par les Etats-Unis en finale de la Coupe du monde de basket

en.title: France's team fails to win first world title, defeated by United States in basketball World Cup final
en.summary: The French women's basketball team lost to the United States in their first-ever World Cup final on Sunday evening, unable to overturn the American squad.

stories.title: Législatives en Suède : la gauche en tête, l’extrême droite recule

en.title: Swedish legislative elections: left-wing leading, far-right declining
en.summary: According to exit polls released Sunday at 20:00, the left-wing opposition is winning the legislative elections held on September 13 in Sweden.

stories.title: Législatives en Suède : la gauche et l'extrême droite au coude-à-coude

en.title: Swedish legislative elections: left and far-right neck and neck
en.summary: Sweden's Sunday legislative elections show the social democrats narrowly ahead, nearly tied with the right-wing and far-right coalition that has governed since 2022. The social democrat leader expressed readiness to form a government.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : à Hénin-Beaumont, Marine Le Pen lance sa « bataille sociale » sur fond de propositions libérales

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: Marine Le Pen launches her "social battle" based on liberal proposals in Hénin-Beaumont
en.summary: At her first campaign rally, the nationalist candidate outlined housing reform proposals including repealing certain legislation, eliminating the energy performance certification requirement, and prioritizing French citizens for public housing.

stories.title: Mondial de basket : les Bleues rêvent de renverser l’hégémonique Team USA en finale

en.title: Basketball World Cup: the French team dreams of overcoming dominant Team USA in the final
en.summary: France's undefeated women's basketball team, led by Gabby Williams, faces the United States in the World Cup final on September 13 in Berlin, two years after losing by one point in the Olympic final.

stories.title: "L'opportunité d'écrire l'histoire du sport français" : Gabby Williams et l'équipe de France peuvent-elles renverser les Américaines pour leur première finale à la Coupe du monde de basket ?

en.title: "The opportunity to write French sports history": Can Gabby Williams and the French team overturn the Americans in their first World Cup basketball final?
en.summary: France's women's basketball team faces the United States in their first World Cup final on Sunday after defeating Germany in the semifinals. The matchup represents a chance for the French to avenge their loss to the Americans at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

stories.title: Spatial : comment Skynopy capte tous les signaux de la croissance

en.title: Space sector: how Skynopy captures all the signals of growth
en.summary: French space technology start-up Skynopy, specialized in satellite ground segment services, signed major partnership agreements with space giants Airbus in January 2026 and Eutelsat in September 2026.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : une première explication attendue entre Sébastien Lecornu et le Sénat

en.title: 2027 Budget: First explanation expected between Sébastien Lecornu and the Senate
en.summary: The Prime Minister will meet with the Senate president on Wednesday to discuss the 2027 budget, following previous difficulties between the executive and the upper chamber.

stories.title: Face au retour de l’inflation, la Fed prête à ressortir l’arme des taux

en.title: Facing inflation's return, the Fed ready to deploy rate weapon
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve may raise interest rates as soon as Wednesday to combat rising inflation. The decision carries major implications for credit, investment, and markets, testing new Fed chair Kevin Warsh's independence from Donald Trump.

stories.title: Sous la menace des drones de Moscou, la Moldavie en première ligne face à l'escalade de la Russie

en.title: Threatened by Moscow drones, Moldova on the front line facing Russian escalation
en.summary: A Russian drone incursion this week delayed Volodymyr Zelensky's departure from Chisinau, highlighting Moldova's vulnerability. The small republic, positioned between Ukraine and Romania, faces intensifying pressure from Moscow.

stories.title: Quand la souveraineté spatiale devient une urgence stratégique

en.title: When space sovereignty becomes a strategic imperative
en.summary: The signing of the 15.7 billion dollar Iris² contract demonstrates European intentions for sovereignty in space telecommunications. However, significant challenges remain in achieving this objective.
